title: Global Geometric Inequalities for Material Bodies
exact_target: Find sharp global bounds for gravitating material bodies and decide which shape restrictions their validity requires.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003919 (OWR-16411-012). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical General Relativity (2018), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2018/36, pp. 2157--2251. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 79.
Geometrical inequalities review (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: No single radius, matter model or inequality is fixed by this programme. Such choices are part of the source question and cannot be filled by a generic Euclidean isoperimetric formula.
